objective: Lower avoidable BUKLOD Connect Supabase cached egress from repeated public sponsored MP4 replays and reduce visible sponsored-video detection latency without degrading image/video quality, AdMob, approvals, or permissions.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: GitHub main source SHA 9f412afd71b74e41995a3a1a63e05e72f78b6e39 inspected as the isolated source comparison baseline on 2026-11-14; this is NOT independently verified production APK, Web, or OTA identity. Live Supabase Connect project logs in 2026-11-14 01:00–02:00 UTC recorded 51 CDN HIT GETs for paid-ad-media, including full and partial requests for a public 48.54 MiB MP4; org dashboard screenshot shows 335.49/250 GB cached egress. Response byte totals are unavailable and attribution of the full 335.49 GB is not claimed.
chosenApproach: Enable expo-video SDK57 native useCaching on stable public sponsor creative URL, preserving full-resolution media and play/audio-focus behavior. Measure viewport on next animation frame rather than a 350ms warmup and keep bounded 350ms checks instead of 900ms on the single focused component. No native package change, backend mutation or media recompression.
selectionRationale: Expo SDK57 supports VideoSource.useCaching on Android/iOS for recurring MP4 playback; existing community video caching does not cover the paid-sponsorship AdVideo component. Existing sponsored view may detect in-viewport items up to 350ms after mount and poll at 900ms. Controlled local caching lowers repeated transfer while retaining immediate eligible playback.
preserveBehaviors: Sponsor campaign eligibility, RLS, payment, rotation, impression and click logs unchanged.
AdMob/IMA ads untouched and never cached to evade serving.
Existing audio focus and sound play/pause controls unchanged.
Photos, full MP4 source resolution and contain framing unchanged.
Only one focused sponsored card viewport measurement; no hidden retry storm.
App/Expo runtime, native packages, Supabase DB, OTA and production unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: Existing paid-sponsorship and audio mixing tests pass
TypeScript and Android staging build/runtime and sponsored media playback verified before any OTA
Compare the same app version/build/runtime recent rolling 15/30/60-minute cached media request and GB after release; do not infer bytes from hits alone.
releaseBlockers: No compiled RC or actual signed staging-device verification.
No exact runtime/OTA production fingerprint and no measured post-deployment egress improvement.
Do not publish directly to production.

alternativeApproaches: Switch the entire app to low-resolution media: violates owner requirement.
Disable or throttle impression serving to save bandwidth: alters monetization and policy.
Rearchitect native media cache or add DRM/player packages: needs new APK without evidence.
Delete or lower quality of stored user assets: destructive and not needed.
